niche.habitat: Lateral junctions of basalt/salt Lanes; buried in crust.

body: Flattened, salt-crusted exoskeleton with six broad tarsi and elastic forelimbs.

chains.trait: Exoskeleton plates mirror salt crystallization patterns.
links: Plates mimic salt -> Hides against bright road surface -> Predator needs cryptic ambush position -> Road is the primary hunting ground.
Bright road -> High contrast environment -> Visual predators require visual camouflage -> F1 star spectrum and F14 salt flats create blinding white roads.

skill.effect: Player hides El Cruce in salt crust, reducing detection range by 70% for 10s.

chains.weakness: Rain or wet wind dissolves salt crust, revealing the predator.
observe: Exoskeleton flakes match surrounding salt geometry.
Plates shift microscopically to match local crystallization.
Predator remains motionless until vibration threshold is met.

journal.en: It does not walk; it becomes the road.

analogues.mechanism: see the cited works; chain wording is the council's own

chains.trait: Fluid-filled sensory pits detect low-frequency vibrations.
links: Pits detect vibration -> Locates rolling prey before sight -> Prey moves too fast for visual reaction -> F18 roller speed exceeds legged pursuit.
Vibration detection -> Efficient targeting on featureless ground -> F9 sound/vibration travels well in 1.5-bar air and hard ground.

skill.effect: Player sees vibration trails of approaching prey from 50m away, ignoring visual blindness.

chains.weakness: Wind noise (F10 gusts) masks vibration cues, blinding the predator.
observe: Sensory pits twitch in response to distant wheels.
Predator tracks vibration source with fluid-shifts.
Predator attacks only when vibration frequency matches rolling signature.

analogues.mechanism: see the cited works; chain wording is the council's own

chains.trait: Magnetite deposits in strike limb disrupt prey navigation.
links: Magnetite disrupts navigation -> Prey swerves or stops -> Easier capture -> F24 prey uses magnetite to follow Lanes.
Magnetite deposit -> Local magnetic anomaly -> F7 crustal remanence provides magnetic 'map' for navigation.

skill.effect: El Cruce's magnetite limb disorients nearby prey, reducing speed by 50% and forcing a stop for 5s.

chains.weakness: Strong external magnetic fields (e.g., player magnetism) can confuse El Cruce's own strike timing.
observe: Prey swerves erratically as El Cruce prepares to strike.
Magnetite glint in the limb catches the K3V light.
Prey stops or spins, losing momentum.

journal.en: It steals the road from beneath their wheels.

chains.trait: Broad, flat tarsi for walking on loose crust.
links: Broad tarsi -> Prevents sinking in dunes/crust -> Off-road mobility -> F22 off-road refuges are essential for survival.
Off-road mobility -> Lanes are islands in rough terrain -> F13 low relief but broken crust surrounds Lanes.

skill.effect: El Cruce traverses loose terrain without stamina loss, allowing flank attacks.

chains.weakness: Slow on hard Lanes; relies on ambush rather than pursuit.
observe: Tarsi spread wide to distribute weight.
Predator moves silently on dune fields.
El Cruce retreats off-road when not hunting.

journal.en: The road is its throne; the dunes are its home.

analogues.mechanism: see the cited works; chain wording is the council's own

relations.note: (council kind 'Prey') El Cruce targets Karrow at junctions where it must cross perpendicular paths.
(council kind 'Prey') El Cruce ambushes Tucket when it uncurls or while rolling downhill onto a junction.
(council kind 'Prey') El Cruce adapts its tarsi to grip thin ice at polar junctions.

body_plan.origin: Six-legged arachnoid lineage adapted for flat-surface locomotion.

secrets: The magnetite limb can be harvested to create a magnetic decoy that lures Skirls off-course.
El Cruce can 'taste' the salt composition to distinguish Karrow from Tucket before striking.
moments: A straight, white road. No wind. A single ripple in the salt crust, and then the road is gone.

journal.en: It waits where the roads kiss.
